scope: Three controlled shared-evidence benchmarks; custom task partitions, not official leaderboard replication
split_seed_policy: Freeze membership once; order seeds only permute evolution tasks, never re-split validation/test

deepresearch_bench_ii.aggregation: Upstream dictionary keeps the last occurrence of an identical dimension/item key

release_audit.scope: Public normalized-question check across all three pinned releases; not a semantic/source-disjoint claim

researchrubrics.role: Primary open-ended quality, evolution and mechanism experiments
researchrubrics.official_split_policy: Custom task partition preserving all inherited quarantine and memberships; not an author train/val/test split
researchrubrics.metric: Pinned weighted ResearchRubrics task score, including negative weights; task-level macro mean

deepsearchqa.role: Independent in-domain evolution for factual answer-set completeness
deepsearchqa.official_split_policy: Custom subdivision of the author's single eval split; public problem_category stratification, no private answer_type stratification or inference hint
deepsearchqa.metric: Task macro F1 from gold-item correctness and excessive answers; also report precision, recall and strict fully-correct rate
deepsearchqa.judge_scope: Metered adaptation of author matching schema/aggregation; shared configured judge is not the author Gemini leaderboard setting

deepresearch_bench_ii.role: Frozen external transfer of the three ResearchRubrics-selected states, no target evolution or selection
deepresearch_bench_ii.official_split_policy: Use the complete author evaluation pool only as held-out target tasks; do not invent a train/val split
deepresearch_bench_ii.metric: Per-task fraction of rubric scores equal to 1; blocked-source -1 rate separate, never a signed mean; macro average tasks
deepresearch_bench_ii.release_note: Pinned JSONL has 9415 rubric items, distinct from paper headline 9430; bilingual rows are not assumed translated pairs
deepresearch_bench_ii.license: Code Apache-2.0; data 129 CC BY 4.0, two CC BY-NC 4.0 (idx 26,110), one CC0 (idx119); retain per-row license and attribution, do not redistribute reports
deepresearch_bench_ii.source_state: ResearchRubrics run-specific VAL winner, sealed before any target score

checkpoint_selection.positions: C0 plus six evenly spaced source batches on each evolving benchmark
checkpoint_selection.validation_scope: Entire fixed validation set on every checkpoint, two independent artifacts per task
checkpoint_selection.selection: Mean complete score or task feasible lower bound over all registered task-repeat slots; missing official score remains null
checkpoint_selection.candidate_scope: All seven whole-state checkpoints per run including C0; identical states reuse outcomes
checkpoint_selection.continuation: Latest trajectory state, no rollback to VAL winner, no early stop, direct per-source writes
checkpoint_selection.test_states: Report all three run-specific winners and preregistered terminal states, not the best run
checkpoint_selection.test_feedback: Seal the entire registered submission inventory before scoring/releasing TEST, including external target submissions

execution_profile.judge_cap_note: v3 overrides v2's4096-token judge cap: DRBII scores batches of50 and DSQA may contain large answer sets. All methods on every benchmark use the same16000 output cap.
execution_profile.retry_policy: No automatic whole-task, generation, execution, or judge retry. One attempted response per criterion/batch; malformed/failed judgments stay missing. This v3 policy supersedes v2's optional transport retry.

cross_benchmark_policy.independent_stores: RR and DSQA evolution start from separate empty stores; no pooling experiences or cross-validation
cross_benchmark_policy.target_transfer: Only RR-selected snapshots transfer to DRBII; target results never choose source benchmark, run or checkpoint
cross_benchmark_policy.duplicate_audit: Reject exact normalized-question cross-benchmark overlap before running; manually review public source/semantic overlap before freeze, without hidden answers or scores
cross_benchmark_policy.exposure_policy: Explicit prior-exposure IDs and their duplicate groups must be in development; held-out exposure requires a versioned amendment, never silent removal
cross_benchmark_policy.score_reporting: Separate benchmark metrics, do not average incompatible weighted RR, F1 and rubric-compliance raw scores
cross_benchmark_policy.statistical_unit: Whole held-out task; preserve paired method/run/repeat records, report language/theme breakdown descriptively

statistical_families.primary: Three benchmark-specific selected-minus-initial paired task contrasts, Holm correction over three p-values for suite-wide efficacy claims
statistical_families.secondary: Selected-minus-JIT and selected-minus-rubric-fixed on each of three benchmarks, Holm correction over six comparisons
statistical_families.mechanism: RR no-rubric/global-only-planning/global-only-attribution/G-versus-GO, Holm correction over four comparisons
statistical_families.reporting: Separate benchmark effects and intervals, independent source-run variation, complete failures; no pooled raw-score league table

cost.unit: Nominal artifact/task slots, not API requests; exact-state reuse reduces actual calls
cost.separate_costs: Common evidence preparation, shared G/GO rubrics, transport retries, and human audit
